title: Stargate: Journey to the Stars
description: A highly customised pack themed around the mythical Stargates, find them, use them, even craft them yourself!
body:
Stargate: Journey to the Stars is a pack themed around, you guessed it, Stargates!
You can find them in the wild, use them to travel to other planets and even build them yourself with enough dedication.
This pack is built for multiplayer, with an official public server!
Come along, make some friends (or don't) and get building!

Features:
- Stargates! Being the primary focus of the pack, you can find, use and create Stargates to travel across the stars in style!
- Technology! The pack has an extensive list of technology for you to use both across the whole pack, and to achieve the end goal of making your own Stargate.
- Custom content! Using KubeJS, the pack has multiple custom recipes for certain items to improve the process of acquiring the Stargate.
- Voice chat! With Simple Voice Chat, you can chat and hang out with friends and other players, using your voice!
- UI improvements! Journey to the Stars has multiple UI improvement mods and resource packs, along with multiple QoL mods.
